```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE)
library(profvis)
library(knitr)
library(rgl)
library(reticulate)
library(microbenchmark)
library(usethis)
options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
rgl::setupKnitr(autoprint = TRUE)
knit_hooks$set(webgl = hook_webgl)

# Import all code for STPCA
setwd("../R")
mds_sources <- list.files()
sapply(mds_sources, source)
```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# test permutation
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE, sigma = .25)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1
dims <- rep(1, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4
time <- Sys.time()
centroid_12 <- plot_MDS_py(x = angles_to_polysph(clusters, dims), dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```

```{r}
res <- inverse_MDS(x = angles_to_polysph(clusters, dims), result = centroid_12, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, method = "NW", angular = TRUE, plot = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Straight trends on (S^2)^2
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, sigma = 0.10)

close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  samp_3[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
plot3d(
  samp_3[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)


clusters <- samp_3[, , 1]
dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters <- cbind(clusters, samp_3[, , i])
}
dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
plot(angles_to_polysph(clusters[, 4:6], c(2)), col = rainbow(n))
```

```{r}

  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^2)^2, small circles, offset by .5
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, t = .5, sigma = 0.10)

clusters1 <- samp_3[, , 1]
dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters1 <- cbind(clusters1, samp_3[, , i])
}
clusters <- normalize_poly(clusters1, dims)
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)


dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
centroid_12 <- plot_MDS_py(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```

```{r}
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
res <- inverse_MDS(x = clusters, result = centroid_12, grid_size = 100, dims = dims, method = "NW", angular = FALSE, plot = TRUE)

plot3d(rbind(clusters[, 4:6], res[, 4:6]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(rainbow(n), rep("black", 100)), pch = 16
)
```
